newsitem.title: POLAND: BIG to offer 11-for-1 shrs for merger.
newsitem.headline: BIG to offer 11-for-1 shrs for merger.

text.p: Polish Bank Inicjatyw Gospodarczych SA (BIG) wants to offer Bank Gdanski shareholders 11 new BIG shares for each Gdanski share to effect the bank's merger, BIG said in a statement on Wednesday.
BIG said its shareholders would vote on June 26 on a new issue of 215,732,000 shares, to be exchanged for its current 63.4-percent-owned subsidiary Bank Gdanski shares.
BIG said it wanted to name the new entity BIG Bank Gdanski SA (BIG BG).
It said the parity of the shares exchange was set after analysing capitalisation of the two banks and after comparing their market value.
Gdanski currently has 19,612,000 shares outstanding and BIG has 163,470,872 shares.
Earlier BIG said it wanted to conclude the merger, which would take effect when BIG takes all the assets of Gdanski, by the end of its financial year, which ends on September 30.
The merger also has yet to be approved by Gdanski's shareholders, likely in late June.
BIG earlier said the merged banks would rank seventh in the ranking of the largest Polish banks according to total assets.
